problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign packages to identical delivery trucks. The packages are as follows:

* Package 1: volume 42 cubic feet
* Package 2: volume 63 cubic feet
* Package 3: volume 48 cubic feet
* Package 4: volume 57 cubic feet
* Package 5: volume 36 cubic feet
* Package 6: volume 49 cubic feet

* Package 17: volume 67 cubic feet

* Package 19: volume 33 cubic feet
* Package 20: volume 36 cubic feet
* Package 21: volume 38 cubic feet
* Package 22: volume 46 cubic feet
* Package 23: volume 66 cubic feet
* Package 24: volume 48 cubic feet
* Package 25: volume 48 cubic feet
* Package 26: volume 41 cubic feet
* Package 27: volume 33 cubic feet
* Package 28: volume 47 cubic feet
* Package 29: volume 66 cubic feet
* Package 30: volume 53 cubic feet
* Package 31: volume 36 cubic feet
* Package 32: volume 56 cubic feet
* Package 33: volume 46 cubic feet
* Package 34: volume 51 cubic feet

Each truck has a maximum capacity of 100 cubic feet. Assign all packages using the fewest number of trucks. Every package must be loaded onto exactly one truck, and the total volume in any truck cannot exceed its capacity.
